elements.element: Preferred: no non-solicit obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: 12.4 as revised still reads "Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel during the term or for 12 months..."

elements.element: Fallback: restriction is mutual (binds both Vendor and Customer)
elements.evidence: "Vendor shall not solicit any Customer personnel during the term or for 12 months..." alongside the Customer covenant in 12.4

elements.element: Fallback: scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "this sentence and the preceding sentence apply only to personnel directly involved in the Services"

elements.element: Fallback: duration of 12 months measured from the end of their involvement
elements.evidence: "for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services" (both sentences)
"do not restrict either Party from placing general advertisements"
"or from hiring any person who makes an unsolicited approach"
"hire, or employ" and "regardless of how the employee applies" deleted; revised covenant restricts only "solicit"

reasons: Fallback is fully satisfied: the Customer covenant is narrowed to solicitation only, a reciprocal Vendor covenant is added, scope is confined to personnel directly involved in the Services, the period is 12 months from the end of involvement, and both general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs are express.
Preferred (no non-solicit on Customer) is not achieved because 12.4 continues to bind Customer, but the locked target level is fallback.

Minimality holds: the single replacement removes the no-hire/24-month sweep with the shortest workable wording, and the inserted sentence supplies the mutuality, scope and carve-outs that were absent; the phrase "so that the restriction is mutual" is descriptive but does not create new obligations or exceptions.
Intent preserved: 12.3 (including the existing no-hire disclaimer) and all other commercial terms are untouched, and the new sentence uses only defined terms (Customer, Vendor, Services).
